title: Flashcards: Official languages, Asia
intro: Flip each card about Asia. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Which language is official in Bahrain?
cards.explain: Arabic is the official language of Bahrain.

cards.front: Which language is official in China?
cards.explain: Chinese is the official language of China.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Cyprus?
cards.explain: Modern Greek (1453-), Turkish are official languages of Cyprus.

cards.front: Which language is official in Georgia?
cards.explain: Georgian is the official language of Georgia.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Israel?
cards.explain: Arabic, Hebrew are official languages of Israel.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Kyrgyzstan?
cards.explain: Kirghiz, Russian are official languages of Kyrgyzstan.

cards.front: Which language is official in Mongolia?
cards.explain: Mongolian is the official language of Mongolia.

cards.front: Which language is official in Maldives?
cards.explain: Dhivehi is the official language of Maldives.

cards.front: Which language is official in Oman?
cards.explain: Arabic is the official language of Oman.

cards.front: Which language is official in Turkmenistan?
cards.explain: Turkmen is the official language of Turkmenistan.

cards.front: Which language is official in Uzbekistan?
cards.explain: Uzbek is the official language of Uzbekistan.

cards.front: Which language is official in Yemen?
cards.explain: Arabic is the official language of Yemen.
